name: Riven
title: the Exile

Q.name: Broken Wings
Q.description: Riven dashes forward, dealing 45/75/105/135/165 + 0.6/0.65/0.7/0.75/0.8×bonus AD physical damage. She can Recast this Ability twice. The first Recast is the same as the original, but the second has a different effect: Recast: Riven leaps forward and slams, dealing 45/75/105/135/165 + 0.6/0.65/0.7/0.75/0.8×bonus AD physical damage and Knocks Up nearby enemies for 0.75 seconds.
Q.summary: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

W.name: Ki Burst
W.description: Riven's sword emits a burst of runic energy, dealing 65/95/125/155/185 + 1×bonus AD physical damage and Stunning for 0.75 seconds.
W.summary: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

E.name: Valor
E.description: Riven quickly dashes and gains 70/95/120/145/170 + 1.1×bonus AD Shield for 1.5 seconds.
E.summary: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.

R.name: Blade of the Exile
R.description: Riven's weapon surges with spiritual energy, granting her 0.2×AD Attack Damage and increased range on damaging Abilities and Attacks for 15 seconds. While active, she can Recast. Recast: Riven fires a wind slash that deals between 100/150/200 + 0.55×bonus AD and 300/450/600 + 1.65×bonus AD physical damage, based on their missing Health.
R.summary: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

Passive.name: Runic Blade
Passive.description: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.
Passive.summary: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Melee skirmisher who weaves attacks between three Q dashes and uses E shield and W stun to win short, fast trades. Snowballs with animation-cancel combos and an execute R wave.
strengths: Lots of mobility: three Q dashes + E dash, can cross walls
W stun and Q3 knock-up give two crowd-control tools in one combo
Runic Blade empowers attacks after every ability: high burst in short trades
R grants AD and range, then a wave that deals more damage to low-health targets
weaknesses: No mana but no sustain either: relies on Ignite/items in long lanes
Weak once her cooldowns are spent
Struggles into hard crowd control and tanky lanes that out-sustain her

curve.lvl2: strong – Q + W stun or E shield
curve.items: strong – first lethality/bruiser item (e.g. Eclipse/Profane Hydra)
curve.late: medium – good split-pusher, falls off vs tanks

profile.curveNote: Q W E together make her short trades safe: E shield absorbs the return damage, W stun stops it.
profile.waveClear: good – Q and W area damage
profile.sustain: low – no self-heal; lifesteal/omnivamp from items

Passive.notes: After each ability, her next attacks deal bonus damage (dodgeable by Jax E).

Q.notes: Three dashes; the 3rd knocks up. Resets her attack timer.

W.notes: Instant area stun around her (short range).

R.notes: Bonus AD and range; recast fires a wave that deals more to low-health targets.

profile.windowAgainst: When her Q charges and E are spent: she can't disengage. Trade when W is down.
